pieces.description: A black fleece pullover hoodie has an oversized hip-length cut, long sleeves, a hood, ribbed cuffs and hem, a kangaroo pocket, and a red jagged lettering print above a large white-and-black chest graphic. Worn TOGETHER with it, as part of the same piece: A small gray canvas crossbody bag has a rounded rectangular shape, dark piping, zippered compartments, and a wide charcoal strap crossing the chest to hold the pouch at the hip. ONE combined piece: the black_graphic_hoodie and the gray_crossbody_bag with its whole strap exactly as worn on it.
